{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794750613622,"sessionID":"ses_e208d1621ffexRhH1IEI4GC9QY","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"fwepu0EWNhhPB1Zi","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/model_geometry.py","content":"import json\nimport numpy as np\n\n# Let's build the exact 3D Signed Distance Function (SDF) of the wooden Rat Trap puzzle\n# and verify it against the initial state and named passages!\n\ndef sdf_box(p, center, half_extents):\n    # p: (..., 3)\n    q = np.abs(p - center) - half_extents\n    return np.linalg.norm(np.maximum(q, 0.0), axis=-1) + np.minimum(np.max(q, axis=-1), 0.0)\n\ndef sdf_cylinder_z(p, x0, y0, z_min, z_max, radius):\n    d_xy = np.hypot(p[..., 0] - x0, p[..., 1] - y0) - radius\n    d_z = np.maximum(z_min - p[..., 2], p[..., 2] - z_max)\n    return np.hypot(np.maximum(d_xy, 0.0), np.maximum(d_z, 0.0)) + np.minimum(np.maximum(d_xy, d_z), 0.0)\n\ndef sdf_sphere(p, center, radius):\n    return np.linalg.norm(p - center, axis=-1) - radius\n\ndef sdf_torus_x(p, center, R, r):\n    # Axis along x: circle of radius R in y-z plane around center\n    dy = p[..., 1] - center[1]\n    dz = p[..., 2] - center[2]\n    dx = p[..., 0] - center[0]\n    q_yz = np.hypot(dy, dz) - R\n    return np.hypot(q_yz, dx) - r\n\ndef sdf_post_with_hole(p, x_min, x_max, z_center, hole_x, hole_r):\n    # 20 mm square bar along x, y in [-10, 10], z in [z_center-10, z_center+10]\n    # minus vertical cylinder hole of radius hole_r at (hole_x, 0)\n    center = np.array([(x_min + x_max)/2.0, 0.0, z_center])\n    half = np.array([(x_max - x_min)/2.0, 10.0, 10.0])\n    d_box = sdf_box(p, center, half)\n    # Subtract cylinder: max(d_box, -d_cyl)\n    d_hole = np.hypot(p[..., 0] - hole_x, p[..., 1] - 0.0) - hole_r\n    return np.maximum(d_box, -d_hole)\n\ndef sdf_wood(p):\n    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float)\n    # Frame rails: opening x in [-60, 60], z in [35, 235]; rails 15 mm thick.\n    # What is frame thickness in y? Usually 15 mm or 20 mm; let's check both (say half_y = 10.0 to be conservative)\n    # Left rail: x in [-75, -60], z in [20, 250]\n    d_left_rail = sdf_box(p, [-67.5, 0.0, 135.0], [7.5, 10.0, 115.0])\n    # Right rail: x in [60, 75], z in [20, 250]\n    d_right_rail = sdf_box(p, [67.5, 0.0, 135.0], [7.5, 10.0, 115.0])\n    # Bottom rail: x in [-75, 75], z in [20, 35]\n    d_bot_rail = sdf_box(p, [0.0, 0.0, 27.5], [75.0, 10.0, 7.5])\n    # Top rail: x in [-75, 75], z in [235, 250]\n    d_top_rail = sdf_box(p, [0.0, 0.0, 242.5], [75.0, 10.0, 7.5])\n    # Base plank: top at z = 20 (let's treat z <= 20 as solid everywhere to be safe!)\n    d_base = 20.0 - p[..., 2] # wait: sdf is p_z - 20! Wait: outside wood has sdf > 0!\n    d_base = p[..., 2] - 20.0 # > 0 when z > 20!\n\n    # Upper post: from x = -35 to x = 60, at z = 168.3, hole at x = -20 (r = 6.5)\n    d_upper_post = sdf_post_with_hole(p, -35.0, 60.0, 168.3, -20.0, 6.5)\n    # Lower post: from x = -60 to x = 35, at z = 101.7, hole at x = 20 (r = 6.5)\n    d_lower_post = sdf_post_with_hole(p, -60.0, 35.0, 101.7, 20.0, 6.5)\n\n    # Left dowel: x = -20, radius 3, from z = 135 to 235, sphere r = 15 at (-20, 0, 135)\n    d_left_dowel = sdf_cylinder_z(p, -20.0, 0.0, 135.0, 235.0, 3.0)\n    d_sphere = sdf_sphere(p, np.array([-20.0, 0.0, 135.0]), 15.0)\n\n    # Right dowel: x = 20, radius 3, from z = 35 to 168.3 - 23 = 145.3, ring at (20, 0, 168.3) R=23, r=4\n    d_right_dowel = sdf_cylinder_z(p, 20.0, 0.0, 35.0, 145.3, 3.0)\n    d_ring = sdf_torus_x(p, np.array([20.0, 0.0, 168.3]), 23.0, 4.0)\n\n    return np.minimum.reduce([\n        d_left_rail, d_right_rail, d_bot_rail, d_top_rail, d_base,\n        d_upper_post, d_lower_post, d_left_dowel, d_sphere, d_right_dowel, d_ring\n    ])\n\npassages = {\n    \"post_upper.hole\": [-15.3, 0.0, 168.3],\n    \"post_lower.hole\": [24.8, 0.0, 101.7],\n    \"ring.inside\": [20.0, 0.0, 182.8],\n    \"gap.sphere_upper\": [-14.0, 0.0, 154.2],\n    \"gap.sphere_lower\": [-14.0, 0.0, 115.8],\n    \"gap.upper_left\": [-47.5, 0.0, 168.3],\n    \"gap.lower_right\": [47.5, 0.0, 101.7],\n}\n\nfor name, pt in passages.items():\n    print(f\"{name:20s}: pt={pt}, clearance_to_wood={sdf_wood(pt):.2f} mm\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/model_geometry.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/model_geometry.py","time":{"start":1794750613608,"end":1794750613620}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1df79084f001dR628FBWPjIjtY","sessionID":"ses_e208d1621ffexRhH1IEI4GC9QY","messageID":"msg_1df787320001yilWLJGEOtH154"}}

Vertex relations: walk CCW around each vertex v in 2D!\n    # When our CCW walk crosses a ray leaving v (with outward tangent T_ray):\n    # CCW tangent at angle theta is (-sin theta, cos theta) = N_left(T_ray)!!\n    # WAIT: CCW walk goes FROM the RIGHT side of T_ray TO the LEFT side of T_ray!\n    # Remember +a goes from LEFT of T_arc to RIGHT of T_arc!\n    # If the edge is oriented OUTWARD from v (T_arc = +T_ray), crossing CCW goes RIGHT -> LEFT = a^{-1}!\n    # If the edge is oriented INWARD to v (T_arc = -T_ray), LEFT of T_arc is RIGHT of T_ray, so crossing CCW goes LEFT(T_arc) -> RIGHT(T_arc) = +a!\n    for vname, pv in pverts.items():\n        inc = []\n        for ei, (u, w) in enumerate(edges):\n            if u == vname:\n                other = pverts[w]\n                ray = other[:2] - pv[:2]\n                ang = np.arctan2(ray[1], ray[0])\n                inc.append((ang, \"-\" + arcs[ei][0])) # outward -> a^-1\n            elif w == vname:\n                other = pverts[u]\n                ray = other[:2] - pv[:2]\n                ang = np.arctan2(ray[1], ray[0])\n                inc.append((ang, arcs[ei][-1])) # inward -> +a\n        if not inc:\n            continue\n        inc.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\n        relations.append([x[1] for x in inc])\n\n    return pverts, arcs, under_splits, which_arc, relations\n\ndef word_of_loop(loop_pts, edges, pverts, which_arc):\n    # Project loop_pts (closed: loop_pts[0] == loop_pts[-1]), start at a point near viewer (e.g. Mouse!)\n    ploop = [proj(p) for p in loop_pts]\n    word = []\n    for k in range(len(ploop) - 1):\n        p1, p2 = ploop[k], ploop[k + 1]\n        crosses = []\n        for ei, (u, v) in enumerate(edges):\n            q1, q2 = pverts[u], pverts[v]\n            res = seg_intersect_2d(p1, p2, q1, q2, eps=1e-7)\n            if res is not None:\n                u_loop, v_edge = res\n                z_loop = p1[2] + u_loop * (p2[2] - p1[2])\n                z_edge = q1[2] + v_edge * (q2[2] - q1[2])\n                if z_loop < z_edge:\n                    # loop goes UNDER this edge!\n                    T_edge = q2[:2] - q1[:2]\n                    T_loop = p2[:2] - p1[:2]\n                    # +a is when loop goes from LEFT of T_edge to RIGHT of T_edge, i.e., det(T_edge, T_loop) < 0\n                    det = T_edge[0]*T_loop[1] - T_edge[1]*T_loop[0]\n                    arc = which_arc(ei, v_edge)\n                    gen = arc if det < 0 else (\"-\" + arc)\n                    crosses.append((u_loop, gen))\n        crosses.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])\n        for _, g in crosses:\n            word.append(g)\n    return word\n\npverts, arcs, under_splits, which_arc, relations = build_presentation(base_edges)\nprint(f\"Total generators: {sum(len(v) for v in arcs.values())}, relations: {len(relations)}\")\nfor r in relations:\n    if len(r) == 1:\n        print(\"Free tip trivial arc:\", r)\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/solve_topology.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/solve_topology.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/solve_topology.py","time":{"start":1794750819900,"end":1794750819929}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1df7c2e22001NTbPrO6HAhmQVW","sessionID":"ses_e208d1621ffexRhH1IEI4GC9QY","messageID":"msg_1df7ab428001uK8ZteLfMrgxXl"}}

Wait: at x=15.3, z=115, y=+3 is IN FRONT OF Nothing — there is NO wood at x=14, z=125, y in [-30, +30]!!]\n# YES!! At x = 14, z = 125, y = 0 is OPEN AIR (between Left Dowel/Sphere x=-20..5 and Right Dowel x=20)!!\n# So (15.3, 3, 115) goes STRAIGHT FORWARD through open air (14, -15, 125) -> (26, -30, 168.3)!!\nM3_after_left_unwrap = [\n    M,\n    (15.3, -4.0, 88.0),\n    (15.3, 1.0, 101.7),\n    (15.3, 3.0, 115.0),\n    (14.0, -15.0, 125.0), # straight forward under Upper Post!\n    (26.0, -30.0, 168.3),\n    (26.0, -14.0, 182.0),\n    (26.0, 14.0, 182.0),\n    (26.0, 14.0, 155.0),\n    (24.8, 3.0, 115.0),\n    (24.8, 1.0, 101.7),\n    (24.8, -4.0, 88.0),\n    M,\n]\n\nprint(\"M1 == M2 (no sph, no ul):\", w_no_sph_no_ul(M1) == w_no_sph_no_ul(M2))\nprint(\"M3 word in full wood:\", w_full_wood(M3_after_left_unwrap))\n\n# NOW LOOK AT M3_after_left_unwrap!!\n# How do we unwrap the RIGHT wrap `(26, -30, 168.3) -> (26, -14, 182) -> (26, 14, 182) -> (26, 14, 155) -> (24.8, 3, 115)`\n# WITHOUT crossing the Right Dowel?!\n# Slide `(26, -14, 182) -> (26, 14, 182)` LEFTWARDS **THROUGH `ring.inside` `(20, 0, 182.8)`**!!\n# Watch carefully where the front leg and back leg go when the top `(26, 0, 182.8)` moves LEFT through `ring.inside` to `(14, 0, 182.8)`:\n#   - Front leg was `(14, -15, 125) -> (26, -30, 168.3) -> (26, -14, 182)`:\n#     Wait: if it enters `ring.inside` from the RIGHT (`x = 26 -> 14`), NO — slide the ENTIRE wrap `(y=-14 -> z=182.8 -> y=+14)` LEFTWARDS THROUGH `ring.inside`!\n#     Inside the Ring (`x = 20`), the Ring's inner radius is 19 mm, and Upper Post is `[-10, 10] x [158.3, 178.3]`!\n#     Wait: at the BOTTOM of Upper Post (`z = 158.3`), the Ring's inner bottom is `z = 149.3`!\n#     Remember `B = (24.8, 3, 115)` is at `x = 24.8` (RIGHT of Ring)!\n#     So after sliding `front -> over -> behind` leftwards through the FRONT, TOP, and BACK crescents of `ring.inside` to `x = 14`,\n#     to get from `(14, +14, 155)` [left of Ring] back to `B = (24.8, 3, 115)` [right of Ring], it goes through the **BOTTOM crescent of `ring.inside`** `(20, 0, 153.8)` (between `z = 149.3` and `z = 158.3`)!!\n#   HOLD EVERYTHING!! TEST THAT!!\nM4_through_ring = [\n    M,\n    (15.3, -4.0, 88.0),\n    (15.3, 1.0, 101.7),\n    (15.3, 3.0, 115.0),\n    (14.0, -15.0, 125.0),\n    (14.0, -14.0, 168.3), # left of Ring, in front of UP!\n    (14.0, 0.0, 182.8),   # left of Ring, over UP!\n    (14.0, 14.0, 168.3),  # left of Ring, behind UP!\n    (14.0, 0.0, 153.8),   # left of Ring, under UP!\n    (20.0, 0.0, 153.8),   # THROUGH bottom of ring.inside (z=153.8 is between Ring 149.3 and UP 158.3!)\n    (26.0, 0.0, 153.8),   # right of Ring, under UP!\n    (24.8, 3.0, 115.0),\n    (24.8, 1.0, 101.7),\n    (24.8, -4.0, 88.0),\n    M,\n]\nprint(\"M3 == M4 (without using sphere or upper_left!!):\", w_no_sph_no_ul(M3_after_left_unwrap) == w_no_sph_no_ul(M4_through_ring))\n\n# AND NOW UNWRAP THAT SECOND WRAP AT x = 14 (`(14,-14,168) -> (14,0,182.8) -> (14,14,168) -> (14,0,153.8)`) USING SPHERE + UPPER_LEFT!\n# Leaving:\nM5_after_second_unwrap = [\n    M,\n    (15.3, -4.0, 88.0),\n    (15.3, 1.0, 101.7),\n    (15.3, 3.0, 115.0),\n    (14.0, -15.0, 125.0),\n    (14.0, 0.0, 153.8),\n    (20.0, 0.0, 153.8),   # through bottom of ring.inside!\n    (26.0, 0.0, 153.8),\n    (24.8, 3.0, 115.0),\n    (24.8, 1.0, 101.7),\n    (24.8, -4.0, 88.0),\n    M,\n]\n# WAIT A SECOND!! {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794751585855,"sessionID":"ses_e208d1621ffexRhH1IEI4GC9QY","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"iOqIiSvVxM0quBOW","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/full_path_check.py","content":"import numpy as np\nfrom model_geometry import sdf_wood\nfrom solve_topology import base_edges, build_presentation, word_of_loop, simplify_group_and_word\n\n# Let's build a swept-homotopy verifier!\n# Given two closed polylines P and Q with the SAME number of vertices V:\n# If for t in linspace(0, 1, 50), every segment of (1-t)*P + t*Q has sdf_wood > 1.25 mm,\n# THEN P and Q are 100% GUARANTEED homotopic in R^3 \\ Wood(r=1.25mm) with ZERO wood contact!!\n# THINK ABOUT THAT!\n# We don't even need group theory once we verify `min_{t in [0,1]} sdf_wood((1-t)*P + t*Q) > 1.25 mm`!!\n# Because linear interpolation in R^3 IS A CONTINUOUS HOMOTOPY, and `sdf_wood > 1.25 mm` everywhere on the swept\n# quadrilateral mesh PROVES mathematically that the string (radius 1.2 mm) NEVER touches wood at any instant!\n\ndef verify_step(P, Q, label=\"\", min_allow=1.25):\n    P = np.asarray(P, dtype=float)\n    Q = np.asarray(Q, dtype=float)\n    assert P.shape == Q.shape, f\"Shape mismatch {P.shape} vs {Q.shape}\"\n    worst_sdf = 1e9\n    worst_info = None\n    max_len = 0.0\n    for ti, t in enumerate(np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, 41)):\n        R = (1.0 - t) * P + t * Q\n        R_closed = np.vstack([R, R[0]])\n        L = float(np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(R_closed, axis=0), axis=1)))\n        max_len = max(max_len, L)\n        for i in range(len(R)):\n            p1, p2 = R_closed[i], R_closed[i+1]\n            seg = np.linalg.norm(p2 - p1)\n            ns = max(6, int(seg * 2.5))\n            s = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, ns)[:, None]\n            pts = p1[None, :] * (1.0 - s) + p2[None, :] * s\n            ds = sdf_wood(pts)\n            idx = int(np.argmin(ds))\n            if ds[idx] < worst_sdf:\n                worst_sdf = float(ds[idx])\n                worst_info = (t, i, np.round(pts[idx], 1))\n    ok = \"OK\" if (worst_sdf >= min_allow and max_len <= 590.0) else \"FAIL\"\n    print(f\"{ok:4s} | {label:42s} | max_len={max_len:5.1f} mm | min_sdf={worst_sdf:5.2f} mm @ t={worst_info[0]:.2f} seg={worst_info[1]} pt={worst_info[2]}\")\n    return ok == \"OK\"\n\n# Let's design the Cleanest Possible Sequence of Keyframes K0 -> K1 -> ... -> K_end\n# all represented with 20 control vertices (with K[0] = Mouse M)!\n# Let's check clearances of key passage points first:\nfor name, p in [\n    (\"lower_hole_L\", [15.25, 0.0, 101.7]),\n    (\"lower_hole_R\", [24.75, 0.0, 101.7]),\n    (\"lower_hole_B\", [20.0, 4.75, 101.7]),\n    (\"lower_hole_F\", [20.0, -4.75, 101.7]),\n    (\"upper_hole_L\", [-24.75, 0.0, 168.3]),\n    (\"upper_hole_R\", [-15.25, 0.0, 168.3]),\n    (\"upper_hole_B\", [-20.0, 4.75, 168.3]),\n    (\"upper_hole_F\", [-20.0, -4.75, 168.3]),\n    (\"ring_top\",     [20.0, 0.0, 182.8]),\n    (\"ring_front\",   [20.0, -14.5, 168.3]),\n    (\"ring_back\",    [20.0, 14.5, 168.3]),\n    (\"ring_bot\",     [20.0, 0.0, 153.8]),\n    (\"sph_lower\",    [-20.0, 0.0, 115.8]),\n    (\"upper_left\",   [-47.5, 0.0, 168.3]),\n]:\n    print(f\"  {name:15s}: sdf = {sdf_wood(p):.2f} mm\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/full_path_check.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/full_path_check.py","time":{"start":1794751585839,"end":1794751585852}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1df87de23001NVbTn3AodVZcpB","sessionID":"ses_e208d1621ffexRhH1IEI4GC9QY","messageID":"msg_1df8700fd001yhVDNjPSG8UMi3"}}
